listTeams: SELECT team_id, name FROM audit_team_workspace ORDER BY name, team_id
createTeam: INSERT INTO audit_team_workspace (team_id, name, revision, payload, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?, ?)
getWorkspace: SELECT revision, payload FROM audit_team_workspace WHERE team_id = ?
saveWorkspace: UPDATE audit_team_workspace SET payload = ?, updated_at = ?, revision = revision + 1 WHERE team_id = ? AND revision = ?
